title: Twelve Chimes  (Les douze coups de midi)

segments.t: Dehors dans la cour, la douzième vibration du clocher s'éteint dans l'air limpide de Portland. Caleb se tient près de la valise bleue tandis que Hannah et Graham patientent discrètement près de l'entrée. Écoutez d'abord la scène.
Twelve chimes... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.
Give it a few minutes, Caleb. City traffic at noon is always slow.
And big brothers never arrive early when they want to look calm.
Look, it is four minutes past twelve already. Maybe he threw my postcard in the trash.
Do not sit down defeated yet! Keep looking toward the corner.
Three years was too long to wait, Hannah. I should have called him two winters ago.
Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?
A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!
My hands are shaking. Is there a tall man in a dark gray coat?
Tall, dark gray coat, looking up at our guesthouse sign right now!
There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.
Shoulders back, Caleb. Remember your three simple sentences. I will open the gate!
Suivons seconde après seconde cette attente chargée d'émotion.
Twelve chimes... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.
'Douze coups... et la rue derrière le portail est complètement déserte.'
Give it a few minutes, Caleb. City traffic at noon is always slow.
'Laissez-lui quelques minutes, Caleb. La circulation en ville à midi est toujours lente.'
And big brothers never arrive early when they want to look calm.
'Et les grands frères n'arrivent jamais en avance quand ils veulent avoir l'air détendus.'
Look, it is four minutes past twelve already. Maybe he threw my postcard in the trash.
'Regardez, il est déjà midi quatre. Peut-être a-t-il jeté ma carte postale à la poubelle.'
Do not sit down defeated yet! Keep looking toward the corner.
'Ne vous rasseyez pas déjà vaincu! Continuez à regarder vers le coin de la rue.'
Three years was too long to wait, Hannah. I should have called him two winters ago.
'Trois ans, c'était trop long à attendre, Hannah. J'aurais dû l'appeler il y a deux hivers.'
Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?
'Ne bougez plus, tous les deux. Vous entendez ce moteur de voiture qui s'arrête au bord du trottoir?'
A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!
'Un taxi jaune vient de se ranger devant le portail en fer!'
My hands are shaking. Is there a tall man in a dark gray coat?
'J'ai les mains qui tremblent. Y a-t-il un homme grand en manteau gris foncé?'
Tall, dark gray coat, looking up at our guesthouse sign right now!
'Grand, manteau gris foncé, il lève les yeux vers l'enseigne de notre maison d'hôtes à l'instant!'
There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.
'Et voilà la cloche du portail. Un coup franc.'
Shoulders back, Caleb. Remember your three simple sentences. I will open the gate!
'Redressez les épaules, Caleb. Rappelez-vous vos trois phrases simples. Je vais ouvrir le portail!'
Réécoutons maintenant toute la scène d'une seule traite.
Twelve chimes... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.
Give it a few minutes, Caleb. City traffic at noon is always slow.
And big brothers never arrive early when they want to look calm.
Look, it is four minutes past twelve already. Maybe he threw my postcard in the trash.
Do not sit down defeated yet! Keep looking toward the corner.
Three years was too long to wait, Hannah. I should have called him two winters ago.
Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?
A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!
My hands are shaking. Is there a tall man in a dark gray coat?
Tall, dark gray coat, looking up at our guesthouse sign right now!
There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.
Shoulders back, Caleb. Remember your three simple sentences. I will open the gate!

À midi quatre, un homme élancé en manteau gris foncé appuie d'un geste franc sur la sonnette du portail! Plus qu'une scène dans ce cinquième épisode: dedans, Arthur ouvre la lettre recommandée. À très vite!
See you soon!
